findings.text: the declared mutation, read from the run pointer's node.negative_control ("drop lane_advisory from the dispatch record assembly so the pointer does not carry it"), occurs nowhere in this log: line 1 reads "Declared mutation: remove the record["lane_advisory"] assignment in reckon/crew/dispatch.py so the live pointer omits the advisory", and a read-only call of reckon.crew.promotion._require_declared_negative_control with the run's own pointer and delivered manifest raises CrewError at the containment test (reckon/crew/promotion.py:3342, receipt in review-declaration-check.log), so the run cannot be promoted as delivered without --waive-negative-control; the observation behind the log is sound - its run reddens exactly test_an_emitted_advisory_reaches_the_written_pointer with KeyError: 'lane_advisory' - so the repair is one line in the log rather than a re-run.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 613a3530fbd697c809a612c50a377e35ff044813 commit by commit; 7059a778 is the record carry, the floor and the message (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2005, :2041, :3887) plus three added test cases and their shared helper gaining a live flag, and b78dcb95 is the plan comment, evidence anchor and figure; all five paths are byte-identical between the node head b78dcb95 and the merged head 1dd8721b this review reads at.
item_verdicts.done_when: I re-ran the gate the done_when names (tests/test_lane_advisory_on_dispatch.py, 12 passed, exit 0 at the tree head, review-gate.log) and read its five clauses against the artefacts; four are carried by :325 (crew.read_pointer, which reads the pointer file from disk at reckon/crew/runs.py:397 rather than the payload), :352, :396 and :398 with the nine pre-existing cases unchanged, but the fifth clause is unmet as delivered: the red log's first line does not repeat the declared mutation, which occurs nowhere in that log (finding 1).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal asks for the advisory a dispatch computed to reach the live pointer record and for the insufficient-evidence message to render the shortfall that fired it; reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3887 copies resolution.lane_advisory onto the record ahead of every write of that record (the three _write_json(pointer_path(run_id), record) calls at :3972, :3976 and :3988), and :2005 and :2041 move both the floor and the rendered count onto input_samples, so both halves of the goal are in the landed code and not only in the payload object the CLI echoes.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the delivered manifest in the run directory; status complete, both commits listed, the focused gate and its 12-passed result recorded, negative_control_log a bare path, the unrelated failure reproduced at base 613a3530 and attributed by file and revision, and the promotion-path half named as a follow-on - but its negative_control_note restates the mutation in words of its own choosing rather than in the declared words, which is finding 1.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five write paths and git diff --name-only 613a3530..b78dcb95 returns exactly those five - reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_lane_advisory_on_dispatch.py, docs/evidence/archive/advise-the-lane-never-force-it-landed.html, docs/figures/advise-the-lane-never-force-it/advisory-reaches-the-pointer.png and docs/plans/advise-the-lane-never-force-it.html - with each commit's own stat inside them (7059a778 the code and its tests, b78dcb95 the plan comment, evidence anchor and figure).

justifications.durability: the pointer case is an assertion proven red-able by the node's own two controls (1 failed, 11 passed each), tests/test_lane_advisory_on_dispatch.py:352 names the condition that fails it (the record assembly writing a null), and :396 and :398 fail if either the message or the floor reverts to the lane's total, though :327 and :328 compare pointer fields against the literals the fixture supplied and so verify the carry rather than a computation.
justifications.evidence: the gate log records 12 passed and I reproduced it at the tree head (review-gate.log), and two controls sit on disk reddening exactly their named cases (control-pointer-carries.log, control-shortfall-floor.log), so what the gate measures is recorded rather than claimed - docked because the done_when's fifth clause fails as delivered and a read-only call of the promotion guard refuses the run over it (reckon/crew/promotion.py:3342, review-declaration-check.log, finding 1).
justifications.fit: the change is two module-private expressions and one guarded assignment in the file's own idiom (compare the guarded carries at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3764), the comment explains why the floor sits on the charged population rather than citing a ticket, and neither the code, the comment nor the three test names carries a plan label, ticket reference or version number under the repository's banned-label scan over the changed lines.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3887 puts the advisory on the record object that :3972 writes to the live pointer, and :2041 renders the count the floor at :2005 compares, which is the whole of what the goal states.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff --name-only 613a3530..b78dcb95 is one of the five declared write paths, and the one behaviour the goal does not state in its own words - moving the floor at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2005 from the lane's usable runs to its chargeable readings - is the change that makes the number rendered and the number compared one population, so it is a documented design judgement carried with a control rather than an unrelated edit.
